title: How to Inspect the Printer Status
overview: Learn how to interpret common printer warnings before changing settings. Check the printer’s display and status lights for paper, ink or toner, open-cover, jam, offline, and error-code indicators.
checklist: Save open work and confirm you are working on the intended device.
Check the printer display and status lights for a paper, ink, toner, cover, or jam warning.
Record what changed and return to the workflow before making additional changes.
common_indicators: The printer displays a paper jam or empty-tray warning.
The printer reports low or empty ink or toner.
A cover-open, offline, or general error indicator is shown.
The printer displays an error code that requires manufacturer-specific guidance.

quiz.question: What should you do first when the printer displays an unfamiliar error code?
answers: Record the code and consult the printer manufacturer’s guidance
Clear the warning without recording it
Change several printer settings at once
quiz.correct_answer: Record the code and consult the printer manufacturer’s guidance

sources.title: Fix Printer Connection and Printing Problems in Windows

notes: Reviewed against Microsoft Support guidance. Common printer error indicators, physical inspection steps, and manufacturer-specific error-code guidance were verified.
